transfer.title: Design transfer guide
transfer.description: Start with reusable foundations, then apply component patterns only when the target contains the matching UI. Local observations remain available without becoming global rules.
transfer.noP0: No foundation currently meets the cross-page, high-confidence threshold. Exact tokens are still available, but they are not presented as global rules.
transfer.noP1: No component pattern currently has enough evidence for contextual reuse.
transfer.p2Summary: Local design observations and coverage gaps ({{rules}} observations · {{recipes}} patterns · {{unknowns}} gaps)

useWhenValues.primary-action: the target needs its principal action
useWhenValues.action: the target needs a supporting or ordinary action
useWhenValues.text-entry: the target needs text entry or selection
useWhenValues.search: the target needs search or filtering
useWhenValues.content-group: related content needs a distinct reusable surface
useWhenValues.navigation: the target needs navigation or scope switching
useWhenValues.tab-navigation: the target needs switching between related views
useWhenValues.content-collection: the target contains a repeated content collection
useWhenValues.structured-data: the target presents structured rows and columns

designDna.validationHelp: Renders the extracted rules on neutral sample UI and checks tokens, states, contrast, and layout one by one.

previewContent.title: Create a new item
previewContent.description: Review the information and confirm the next step.
previewContent.summary: A neutral content block for checking hierarchy, rhythm, and surface treatment.

profile-grounding.passed: Every preserve rule retains at least one validated evidence citation.
profile-grounding.failed: At least one preserve rule has no evidence citation.
profile-grounding.suggestion: Remove the unsupported rule or reinterpret it from additional evidence.

token-spacing.passed: All recipe gaps use extracted spacing tokens.
token-spacing.failed: The recipe contains an off-scale gap.
token-spacing.suggestion: Replace off-scale gaps with extracted spacing values.

rule-references.failed: At least one rule reference does not exist.
rule-references.suggestion: Remove references that are not present in the validated profile.

state-coverage.rule: State scenarios include focus and error surfaces
state-coverage.passed: The state recipe includes focus and error fields.
state-coverage.failed: The state recipe is missing focus or error coverage.
state-coverage.unknown: This scenario does not attempt full state validation.
state-coverage.suggestion: Add allowlisted focus and error field states to the state recipe.

text-contrast.rule: Primary text and surface colors meet WCAG AA contrast
text-contrast.passed: The inferred primary pair meets the 4.5:1 threshold.
text-contrast.failed: The inferred primary pair is below the 4.5:1 threshold.
text-contrast.unknown: A reliable primary text/surface token pair could not be identified.
text-contrast.suggestion: Choose a higher-contrast extracted foreground/surface pair.

horizontal-overflow.rule: Neutral validation recipes avoid fixed-width horizontal overflow
horizontal-overflow.passed: The allowlisted layout uses bounded responsive columns and no fixed width.
horizontal-overflow.failed: The recipe requests more than four columns.
horizontal-overflow.suggestion: Reduce the validation grid to four or fewer responsive columns.

reduced-motion.rule: The neutral validation recipe remains usable with reduced motion
reduced-motion.passed: The allowlisted recipe contains no required animation or time-dependent interaction.

overview.label: Overview
overview.title: Extracted design facts
overview.observedDescription: Everything below was directly observed by the browser — screenshots, colors, typography, and page structure — with no AI guesswork.
overview.legacyTitle: This record has no page evidence
overview.legacyDescription: This analysis was saved before page evidence existed, so it has no screenshots or structure data. Its colors, typography, and exports still work.
overview.sectionCoverage: Identified sections cover {{percent}}% of the page
overview.statesPassive: {{count}} deduped interaction state patterns (hover, focus, active, disabled)
overview.statesPassiveObservations: {{count}} passive CSS state observations (no user action performed)
overview.statesPassiveTooltip: Passive states come from CSS declarations only — no clicks or input were performed. This describes how the data was captured, not a confidence level.
overview.statesResponsive: {{count}} layout differences found across screen sizes
overview.statesEmpty: No interaction states or screen-size differences were recorded.
overview.noLimitations: No capture limits in this analysis.

limitations.fewerPages: Some automatically selected pages were not captured; this result covers {{pages}} completed pages.
limitations.singleViewport: Only one screen size was captured, so layout changes across sizes could not be compared.
limitations.horizontalOverflow: At least one viewport has horizontal overflow; off-screen content may be clipped instead of responsively reflowed.
limitations.noSections: No clear page sections could be identified.
limitations.noActiveInteractions: Some interactions were not observed because they could not be triggered safely.
limitations.noInteractionStates: No interaction state changes (such as hover or focus styles) were captured.
limitations.noMedia: No major image or video regions were found on the captured pages.
limitations.noMediaClassification: The purpose of media regions could not be determined.
limitations.extractionDegraded: At least one extraction stage degraded, so the result may be incomplete.
limitations.unknown: Some data could not be captured.

sessions.title: Website sign-ins
sessions.description: Used to access pages visible only after sign-in during analysis. View or remove website sign-ins saved by Imprint here.
sessions.notice: Signing in is not required: public and sign-in pages remain analyzable, but content available only after sign-in cannot be accessed. States stay in Imprint's isolated browser and never read or affect your everyday Chrome profile.
sessions.emptyDescription: A website appears here only after you choose to sign in during analysis and Imprint verifies it.
sessions.error: The saved sign-in could not be removed. Close any active sign-in browser and try again.

auth.requiredDescription: The target currently shows a sign-in page or blocking sign-in prompt. You can sign in with an isolated Imprint browser, or continue and analyze only the page that is currently visible.
auth.privacy: Imprint never reads your everyday Chrome profile. If you sign in, the session is saved only in a separate local browser profile for this website.
auth.loginWindowDescription: A separate Chrome window is open. Finish signing in there, then return to Imprint and continue.
auth.loginIncompleteTitle: Sign-in still appears to be required
auth.loginIncompleteDescription: The target page still shows a sign-in barrier. Finish the remaining steps in Chrome, then try continuing again.
auth.anonymousWarningDescription: This result only describes the sign-in page or prompt shown to signed-out visitors.

comparisonPicker.title: Compare two analyses
comparisonPicker.description: Choose the analyses from before and after a change. One analysis may contain multiple pages and screen sizes.
comparisonPicker.loadFailed: Analysis records could not be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
comparisonPicker.emptyDescription: Analyze the same website route at least twice. Only a later record for that route can be selected as the later analysis.
comparisonPicker.comparabilityNote: Only before-and-after records for the same route are shown. If capture conditions differ, the result explains what can still be compared.

referenceComparison.title: Analysis comparison
referenceComparison.factOnly: Reports observed changes only where the two captures can be compared reliably. A change is not automatically a defect.

visualDiff.title: Screenshot differences
visualDiff.description: Compares the saved screenshots. Text, numbers, ads, and layout can all appear as pixel differences; an outline means that at least part of the enclosed area changed, not that every item inside it changed.
visualDiff.highlightLegend: At least part of each outlined area differs between screenshots
visualDiff.noVisibleDifference: No difference reached the visual display threshold.
visualDiff.heightAligned: The page height changed. Matching content above and below the change was aligned to avoid marking the whole shifted page.
visualDiff.scaled: The difference regions were calculated from a proportional preview; zoom uses the saved full-resolution screenshots.

errors.load-failed: One of the saved screenshots is unavailable or cannot be read.
errors.width-mismatch: The screenshot widths differ, so a pixel-aligned visual difference would be misleading.

referenceComparison.captureConditionDescription: The analyses can still be compared, but these recorded differences limit how the result should be interpreted.
referenceComparison.nonBlockingDifferencesDescription: These differences are recorded for traceability and did not cause the comparison to fail.

excludedPages.title: Partial coverage
excludedPages.description: Comparing {{count}} shared eligible pages. Excluded pages do not participate in the verdict.

issues.dom-still-mutating: a page that was still changing

report.title: Imprint Analysis Comparison Report
report.reasonsTitle: Why no comparison verdict was possible
report.noChanges: No changes were reported in comparable evidence.

limitations.section-level-properties-only: Compares only the order, layout mode, display/position, maximum width, and grid column count of matched sections; spacing is reported separately
limitations.unresolved-entities-excluded: Similar elements that cannot be paired reliably are excluded to prevent false change reports
limitations.medium-confidence-entity-matches: Some sections have only medium-confidence identity matches
limitations.observed-interaction-styles-only: Compares only observed interaction-style groups aligned by page, trigger, and property set
limitations.interaction-observations-unpaired: At least one interaction observation or coverage condition could not be aligned
limitations.matched-responsive-observations-only: Compares only observed responsive behavior for matched sections across the same viewport pair
limitations.responsive-observations-unpaired: At least one responsive observation or section identity could not be aligned
limitations.single-viewport: At least one analysis has only one viewport, so responsive behavior cannot be compared

order.fewerBefore: In {{context}}, the number of identified page sections before the {{role}} changed from {{from}} to {{to}}, a decrease of {{delta}}.
order.moreBefore: In {{context}}, the number of identified page sections before the {{role}} changed from {{from}} to {{to}}, an increase of {{delta}}.

summaries.property_one: In {{context}}, the matched {{role}} section changed its {{property}} from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”.
summaries.property_other: In {{context}}, {{count}} matched {{role}} sections changed their {{property}} from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”.

layoutChange.orderExplanation: This proves that the section's relative page structure changed. By itself, it cannot distinguish deletion, merging, reordering, or a change in section detection.

reasons.missing-evidence: One capture does not contain Design Evidence.
reasons.missing-capture-manifest: One capture does not contain a Capture Manifest.
reasons.schema-mismatch: The captures use different evidence schema versions.
reasons.capture-manifest-schema-mismatch: The captures use different Capture Manifest schema versions.
reasons.capture-environment-mismatch: A capture environment setting that can affect extracted tokens differs.
reasons.stabilization-mismatch: The captures used different stabilization strategies.
reasons.route-mismatch: The entry routes do not match.
reasons.page-set-mismatch: The eligible page and viewport sets cannot be aligned.
reasons.access-mode-mismatch: The captures used different visitor or signed-in access modes.
reasons.language-mismatch: The captures used different page languages.
reasons.incomplete-coverage: At least one capture has incomplete page or viewport coverage.
reasons.missing-page-health: At least one captured page has no health result.
reasons.no-common-eligible-pages: The captures have no shared page and viewport that is eligible for comparison.
reasons.unhealthy-page: At least one captured page is not eligible as comparison evidence.

limitations.browser-environment-differs: The browser product, version, execution mode, operating system, or architecture differs.
limitations.tool-version-differs: The captures were produced by different Imprint versions; this alone does not prevent comparison.
limitations.incomplete-coverage: The verdict covers only the shared eligible pages captured by both analyses.
limitations.unhealthy-pages-excluded: Pages without comparison-eligible evidence were excluded from the verdict.
limitations.exact-observed-values-only: Supported token values and structured observations are compared exactly; perceptual tolerances are not yet calibrated.
limitations.entry-and-captured-page-set-only: Comparability is limited to the recorded entry route, page set, and viewports.

errors.analysis-not-found: This history record no longer exists.
errors.analysis-order-invalid: The later analysis must be newer than the earlier analysis.
errors.invalid-analysis-data: One of the stored captures cannot be read safely.
